## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #01 BLUEPRINT
### Email PDF Invoice to Excel / Google Sheets Assistant

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep01&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Invoice_Date | Vendor_Name | Invoice_Number | Tax_Amount | Total_Amount | File_Name | Status`
* [Open Episode #01 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep01/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qHAa30IxU_A)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Watches Gmail 24/7 for incoming invoices & checks for PDF attachments.
* **Zone 2:** Uses the native **Extract from File (PDF)** node + Regex Parser to read real PDF invoice totals, tax & invoice IDs.
* **Zone 3:** Archives the PDF to Google Drive and appends a clean row to Google Sheets.

---
*📂 Need more free templates? Visit [360rev-hub.github.io](https://360rev-hub.github.io/?src=json_footer)*

## STEP 1: Watch Gmail & Detect PDF Attachment
1. Double-click **1. Watch Incoming Invoices (Gmail)** and connect your Google account.
2. Filter `subject:(invoice OR receipt) has:attachment` automatically downloads binary PDF files.
3. **2. Has PDF Attachment?** routes binary PDFs to the native PDF text extractor.

## STEP 2: Real PDF Text Extraction & Smart Field Parser
1. **3. Extract Text from PDF File** (`n8n-nodes-base.extractFromFile`) reads the raw text inside the attached PDF.
2. **4. Parse Vendor, Invoice #, Tax & Total** extracts real accounting fields from the PDF text + email metadata (with instant sample fallback when clicking *Test workflow*).

## STEP 3: Archive PDF to Drive & Log to Google Sheets
1. Double-click **5. Archive PDF Invoice to Google Drive** to pick your accounting folder.
2. Double-click **6. Append Invoice Row to Google Sheets** -> select your spreadsheet.
3. Click **Test workflow**, then flip the top-right switch to **Active** for 24/7 cloud bookkeeping on [Hostinger KVM 1](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep01&src=json_step3)!
